title: Isolation-forest anomaly detection in the Fink broker leads to discoveries in ZTF alerts
summary: The Fink broker's anomaly detection pipeline turns Zwicky Transient Facility light curves into features and ranks alerts with an isolation forest trained on archival ZTF data; the ten most anomalous candidates each night go to experts, whose feedback retrains the model with Active Anomaly Discovery. In its first year (from 25 January 2023) it led to discovery and follow-up of the rare AM CVn system Fink J062452.88+020818.3, the UX Ori-type star Fink J222324.32+744222.0 and the unusual Type II supernova SN 2023mtp. It also triggered 33 supernovae, 30 of them previously unreported, and nine new dwarf novae. First-year performance paper; the abstract is the only material read.
